1.name: Corruption Protection
1.description: Ward your target against subversion, increasing their Corruption Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

1.name: Invisibility versus Animals
1.description: Shroud a target group member in a cloak of invisibility, rendering them unseen by beasts for 10 minutes.

1.name: Polar Align: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, causing them to focus their attacks on you. Triggers cooldown of Martial abilities.

1.name: Strike
1.description: Strikes your target for 1 (L1) to 50 (L60) Melee Damage, with 150% (L1) to 350% (L60) Damage Variance. Triggers cooldown of Might abilities.

1.name: Throw
1.description: Throw a throwing weapon at your target. This skill requires a throwing weapon.

1.name: Weak Heal
1.description: Weakly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 6 Health.

2.name: Truestrike Aura
2.description: Heighten the senses of your group, increasing their Archery, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Throwing, and Slashing by 5 and Dexterity by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60).

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Burning Embers
4.description: Burns your target for 60 seconds, dealing 1 Fire Damage every 6 seconds and decreasing AC by 1. Max 3 Stacks. This spell does not stack with itself or any others in the same line. Requires Fire Beetle Eye.

5.name: Snare
5.description: Several small roots emerge from the ground and cling to your target's feet, decreasing their Movement Speed by 35% for 30 seconds.

6.name: Woodskin
6.description: Solidifies the skin of a friendly target, increasing their Armor Class by 5 for 30 minutes.

7.name: Fire Protection
7.description: Ward your target against heat, increasing their Fire Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

8.name: Cure Disease
8.description: Cures your target, removing one Disease effect.

8.name: Minor Heal
8.description: Slightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 10 Health.

8.name: Shroud
8.description: Camouflage yourself in nature's shroud, rendering you unseen by the living for 10 minutes.

9.name: Twisting Roots
9.description: Root your target with twisting tendrils, immobilizing them for 30 seconds. This spell has a chance to be removed by damage.

10.name: Whistling Shot
10.description: Fire a whistling shot at your target, dealing 90% Weapon Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage, and increasing Threat by 25 (L1) to 250 (L60).

11.name: Fire Arrows
11.description: Imbue your arrows with fire, increasing your Ranged Damage dealt by 1 (L1) to 7 (L60) Fire Damage. Additionally, each ranged attack grants you a chance to activate Fire Arrow Advantage reducing cast time of your next Flameburst or Burning Embers line by 100% for 10 seconds.

effects.stat: cast time of your next Flameburst or Burning Embers line

11.name: Imbue Weapon: Fire
11.description: Imbued your weapon with fire, granting you a chance to activate Fire Attack on melee attacks for 15 minutes. Fire Attack: Unleash a fire attack, dealing 7 (L1) to 75 (L60) Fire Damage.

11.name: Poison Protection
11.description: Ward your target against toxins, increasing their Poison Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

12.name: Cold Protection
12.description: Ward your target against frost, increasing their Cold Resistance by 4 for 1 hour.

12.name: Lesser Heal
12.description: Lightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 25 Health.

12.name: Lull Exceptional Beasts
12.description: Lull a target beast, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

13.name: Sneak
13.description: Begin to sneak, causing you to be hidden from enemies while behind them.

14.name: Truestrike
14.description: Make your attacks strike true, increasing your Archery and Offense by 10 and Physical Damage dealt by 100% for 30 seconds.

effects.stat: Archery and Offense by 10 and Physical Damage dealt

15.name: Camouflage
15.description: Camouflages a target group member in nature's shroud, rendering them unseen by the living for 19 minutes. This spell can only be used outdoors. This spell has a strong chance to end early.

15.description: Search the corpses around you, looking for arrows

16.description: Glaze the eyes of your target with a magical coating, granting them the ability to see magical effects when considering targets for 1 hour.

17.name: Fear Beast
17.description: Fears an enemy beast, causing them to run away in terror. Doing damage has a small chance to break this effect early.

18.name: Enduring Breath

19.name: Prickly Tunic
19.description: Wrap yourself in a prickly tunic, increasing your Armor Class by 10 and granting you a damage shield that deals 1 damage when hit for 1 hour.

20.name: Minor Regeneration
